questions.question: In Philippi, a dealer in purple cloth named Lydia listened to Paul speak. Who opened her heart to respond to his message?
In Philippi, Paul grew aggravated by a slave girl's shouting and commanded the spirit inside her to leave. In whose name did he command it?
While Paul and Silas were locked in prison in Philippi, what were they doing at midnight?

answers.text: Praying and singing hymns to God
Quietly planning a way to escape

questions.question: After an earthquake opened the prison doors in Philippi, what did the jailer ask Paul and Silas?

answers.text: What must I do to be saved
Who sent this earthquake on us
How did your chains come loose
